draft.emotion: polite, friendly, and welcoming, standard for professional or social encounters
notes: 'Dzień dobry' (literally 'good day') is used for both 'good morning' and 'good afternoon' until early evening, when 'dobry wieczór' (good evening) replaces it.
Unlike 'cześć', which is informal for friends and family, 'dzień dobry' is the polite choice for shops, offices, strangers, and older people.
